scope: Exact integer byte totals returned by the official GitHub Languages API for the canonical repositories on 2026-10-16. Predominant language is the largest reported byte bucket; totals include generated, vendored, build, and fixture sources and do not measure only core implementation.

records.evidence: Exact repository-wide byte totals returned by the official GitHub Languages endpoint on 2026-10-16. Rust is the largest reported bucket. Counts include the QEMU integration, firmware, tests, scripts, and other repository files.
